label: Ubiquiti UniFi 5G Backup
description: 5G RedCap/LTE backup modem for UniFi: one GbE RJ45, PoE input, nano-SIM plus eSIM.
notes: Vendor figures from the Ubiquiti tech specs page: Networking Interface **(1) GbE RJ45 port**, **5G RedCap and LTE**, SIM **(1) Nano-SIM (4FF) plus (1) eSIM**, PoE interface (1) input, 122 g. **RedCap is a reduced-capability 5G profile** - it is not the same ceiling as full 5G NR, so a failover plan should not assume the same throughput as the U5G-Max in this catalogue, which is full 5G NR on a 2.5G port.
